teams.label: Label
teams.makeATeamOrLabel: Make a team or label under Teams and labels first.
teams.theySeeTheirHousesTeams: They see their houses, teams and labels on their Record in the Linara app.
teams.theyStayInTheirOwn: They stay in their own team's group, and show when you look at these too.
teams.theyStayEmployedAndPaid: They stay employed and paid here; those houses can give them tasks. Their managers see their shift, not their pay.
teams.thePartOfTheHouse: The part of the house they work in. The Pass, Schedule and Money group by it.
teams.anythingElseWorthFilteringBy: Anything else worth filtering by. They see their team and labels on their Record.
teams.aTeamIsThePart: A team is the part of the house someone works in; the Pass, Schedule and Money group by it. Labels are anything else worth filtering by.
teams.noTeamsOrLabelsYet: No teams or labels yet. With a large staff, start with one team per department.
